entities.name: Spectacle Summit
entities.description: Elementally charged rocky canyon on Arcavios where Prismari holds Summitfest.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: Prismari student affected by trauma from the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Glassyk
entities.description: First-year student who rescued Rootha and was inside the unstable skywhale.

entities.name: Dean Nassari
entities.description: Prismari dean who collaborated with Rootha.

entities.name: Skywhale
entities.description: Elemental whale that became unstable and flooded the festival.

entities.name: Living Flame
entities.description: Spell Rootha channeled to neutralize the elemental.

entities.name: Night of Flame
entities.description: Name given to the 4565 AR incident, starting a tradition.

entities.name: The Muse
entities.description: Rock formation shaped like a woman where artists contribute.

events.summary: At Summitfest in 4565 AR, Rootha suffers a near-fatal fall and is rescued by Glassyk.
events.quote: experienced a near-fatal fall from a ridge and was rescued by first-year student Glassyk

events.summary: The skywhale becomes unstable and expands into a massive uncontrolled construct causing flooding and damage.
events.quote: became unstable and expanded into a massive, uncontrolled construct

events.summary: Rootha and Dean Nassari channel the Living Flame, neutralizing the elemental; the event becomes the Night of Flame.
events.quote: the event became known as the Night of Flame

relations.quote: Prismari hosts its annual arts festival, Summitfest, at the canyon
collaborated with the dean by channeling a spell she called the Living Flame
